item.title: The Black Swan
item.description: An ex-pirate contends with rowdy buccaneers and a love-hate relationship with an aristocratic woman who's tougher than she seems.

item.title: The Call of the Wild
item.description: After losing his money, a prospector searches for gold with the help of his sled dog and a woman abandoned by her husband.

item.title: Rachel and the Stranger
item.description: A widowed farmer marries a servant, but the arrival of his old friend threatens his new life.

item.title: 3:10 To Yuma
item.description: A mild-mannered cattle rancher takes on the task of conveying a captured outlaw to the train that will deliver him to prison. This mission turns into a nerve-racking, cat-and-mouse game that tests each man's particular brand of honor.

item.title: Halls of Montezuma
item.description: With just 24 hours before the Japanese launch a rocket defense that will cripple the local Allied military forces, a rough-and-tumble group of Marines dig into a Japanese-held island in the Pacific to locate and destroy the rocket command.

item.title: Lifeboat
item.description: When their ship is sunk by a German U-Boat missile during WWII, eight survivors must overcome their differences in order to survive at sea.

item.title: Happy Land
item.description: Lew Marsh, a pharmacist to the small community of Hartfield, Iowa, is lunching with his devoted wife Agnes when a telegram arrives notifying them that their only child, Russell, whom they called Rusty, has been killed in action during World War II.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: A fox is convinced by listening to the radio that he'll be soon skinned and worn as a fashionable clothing article. In a strange twist of fate he ends up trying to get into the Sterling Silver Fox Fur farm.
